title: His sons and the lack of other musicians in the family
summary: His son plays piano and has a band in New York, and Sing is the only musician in the family.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: My son played more piano than me but he don't play what I play.
What kind of piano does he play?
How old is your son now?
He's 31 now. Does he play in a band or play anywhere? Yeah. Who does he play with?
Oh, he's got his own band. Yeah. Where does he play?
Oh. What about your other son? Does he play anything?
He's like your brother, huh? He can't whistle or anything? No. No. Is there anybody else in your family? Any uncles, aunts, cousins? Nobody else.
I'm the only one. You just decided you wanted to play?
